rule: Every intelligence layer must feed scoring, dossier generation, targeting, or operational decision support. No decorative layers allowed.

layers.name: Federal Intelligence
layers.purpose: Identify federal-level law enforcement, public safety, grant, training, and risk signals relevant to target agencies.

layers.name: State-Level Intelligence
layers.purpose: Map state POST, training commissions, agency directories, certification bodies, and state law enforcement structures.

layers.name: Local Agency Intelligence
layers.purpose: Validate municipal, county, campus, tribal, and public safety agencies using official local sources.

layers.name: Training Infrastructure
layers.purpose: Detect training divisions, academies, field training programs, professional standards units, and officer development paths.

layers.name: Budget and Funding Signals
layers.purpose: Identify budgets, grants, procurement cycles, public safety funding, and training allocation signals.

layers.name: Behavioral / Activity Signals
layers.purpose: Capture activity patterns, regional pressure, public safety incidents, and relevant operational signals.

layers.name: Geographic / Territory Signals
layers.purpose: Map agency jurisdiction, regional clusters, travel corridors, city density, and operational proximity.

layers.name: Command Structure
layers.purpose: Infer and verify command staff, training commanders, academy leaders, and internal routing hierarchy.

layers.name: Procurement Pathways
layers.purpose: Identify how agencies approve training, who routes vendor inquiries, and where purchasing authority sits.

layers.name: Communication Channels
layers.purpose: Validate phone paths, department routing, official contact pages, and verified non-generic access points.

layers.name: Incident / Risk Signals
layers.purpose: Track relevant incidents, regional enforcement concerns, motorcycle-club activity context, and officer safety relevance.

layers.name: Engagement / Response Tracking
layers.purpose: Track calls, referrals, replies, follow-ups, interest, and conversion state.
